subject: Cerebral artery elasticity declined measurably in just 18 months
script: From Agewell Brief: Cerebral artery elasticity declined measurably in just 18 months. A novel optical technique reveals that cerebral arterial elasticity declines measurably in just 18 months, and cardiovascular risk burden is the hidden driver. Your brain is a vascular glutton. It consumes roughly 20% of your cardiac output, yet it has no energy reserves. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
